Package org.jwcarman.codec.autoconfigure

package org.jwcarman.codec.autoconfigure
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ForyCodecAutoConfiguration
    Registers a ForyCodecFactory when the application defines a ThreadSafeFory bean.
    GsonCodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a GsonCodecFactory when the Gson backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
    Jackson2CodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a Jackson2CodecFactory when the Jackson 2.x backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
    JacksonCodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a JacksonCodecFactory when the Jackson 3.x backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
    JsonbCodecAutoConfiguration
    Registers a JsonbCodecFactory when the JSON-B backend and API are on the classpath and no other backend has claimed the CodecFactory slot.
    ProtobufCodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a ProtobufCodecFactory when the Protocol Buffers backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
